sa: पातिताश्च त्वया वीराः कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्। भक्षितानि च सैन्यानि प्राप्तं ते परमं यशः॥ त्यज तद्वानरानीकं प्राकृतैः किं करिष्यसि। सहस्वैकं निपातं मे पर्वतस्यास्य राक्षस।५६।।
en: You have felled heroes done deeds difficult of being performed, and have devoured the warriors; and you have thus attained renown. But let go now the monkey-army. What shall you do with the ignoble? Do you, O Raksasa bear the descent of this mountain.

sa: एतदर्थं हि जीवामि कृत्वा ज्ञातिवधं महत्। अस्य शुश्रूषणं कार्यं मया नित्यमतन्द्रिणा॥
en: Having killed all my kinsmen, I live for him alone. My great duty is to always serve him with particular care.

sa: विक्रमं वृत्रहा जह्याद् धर्मं जह्याच धर्मराट्। न त्वहं सत्यमुत्स्स्रष्टुं व्यवसेयं कथंचन॥
en: The slayer of Vitra (Indra) may renounce his prowess and the king of justice his impartiality, but I cannot renounce truth.”

sa: स प्रसेनजितं राजन्नधिगम्य नराधिपम्। रेणुकां वरयामास स च तस्मै ददौ नृपः॥
en: O king, going to the ruler of men, Prasenjit, he asked Renuka in marriage; and the king bestowed her upon him.

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यामि धर्मज्ञं राजानं सत्यवादिनम्। जनकं पृष्टसीतं तं कुशलं जनसंसदि॥
en: What shall I speak to that virtuous, truthful king Janaka when he shall interrogate me about Sītā's welfare in an assembly?

sa: पुरा रामः पितुर्वाक्याद्दण्डके विजने वने। उषित्वा नव वर्षाणि पञ्च चैव महावने॥
en: Formerly did Rāma go through miserics, residing in the forest of Dandaka, at the command of his sire for fourteen years.

sa: स तु तेन प्रहारेण निकुम्भो विचचाल च। स्वस्थश्चापि निजग्राह हनूमन्तं महाबलम्॥
en: Being struck with his (Hanuman's) fist Nikumbha was greatly moved and restoring himself attacked the mighty Hanumān and pulled him up.

sa: व्यवस्थानं च ते धर्मे कुलाचारं च लक्षये। प्रतिपत्तिं च कृच्छ्रेषु शुक्राङ्गिरसयोरिव॥
en: I know you are like Indra and Angiras in firmness, in virtuous, in preserving familycustoms and in the presence of mind.

sa: ऊषुः प्रहष्टमनसो विहरन्तो वनाद् वनम्। इति तेऽभिहितं राजन् यत् पृष्टोऽहमिह त्वया॥
en: Delightedly spent their days wandering from forest to forest. O king, I have thus, as asked by you, recounted the story.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच भवतामापदं ज्ञात्वा ऋषेः परमकोपनात्। द्रौपद्या चिन्तितः पार्था अहं सत्वरमागतः॥
en: Krishna said: O son of Pritha, knowing your difficulty from the highly wrathful Rishi implored by Draupadi I soon came here.

sa: इति चिन्तापरान् दृष्ट्वा निःश्वसन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः। उवाच वचनं श्रीमान् कृष्णः प्रत्यक्षतां गतः॥
en: Seeing them thus stricken with anxiety and breathing long deep sighs frequently the graceful Krishna suddenly appeared before them and said,

sa: कच्चिन्न दुष्टो व्रजसि रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। इयं ते महती सेना शङ्कां जनयतीव मे॥
en: But do you go after Rāma of energetic acts with some evil intention? This vast force of yours raise my apprehension/

sa: देवाश्च सर्वे मुनिपुङ्गवाश्च गन्धर्वविद्याधरपन्नगाश्च। भूतानि सर्वाणि सहान्ति तत्र जग्मुः परां प्रीतिमतुल्यरूपाम्॥
en: All the celestials, the foremost ascetics, the Gandharvas, the Vidyādharas, the Pannāgas, and all other great heroes, attained excess of delight.

sa: न मृष्यति हतं नूनं भूरिश्रवसमाहवे। यत्र यात्येष तत्र त्वं चोदयाश्वान् जनार्दन॥
en: Surely, he cannot endure the destruction of Bhurisrava in battle. O Janaradana, drive the horses towards the place whither he goes.

sa: न तथा सुखयत्यग्निर्न प्रावारा न कम्बलाः। शीतवातार्दितं लोकं यथा तव मरीचयः॥
en: Neither fire, nor shelter, nor woolen blankets give greater comfort to one in cold than what is got from your rays.

sa: स तु हर्षात् तमुद्देशं जनौघो विपुलः प्रयान्। अशोभत महावेगः सागरस्येव पर्वणि॥
en: And as the mighty throng began to proceed, it resembled the swell of the sea on the occasion of a parva.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच प्रज्ञा च ते भार्गवस्येव शुद्धा धर्म च त्वं परमं वेत्थ सूक्ष्मम्। समश्च त्वं सम्मतः कौरवाणां पथ्यं चैषां मम चैव ब्रवीहि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: Your intelligence is as great as that of Bhargava (Shukra), you know all the subtleties of holy Dharma. You look on all the Kurus with and equal eye. Tell me what is good for me and for them (the Kurus).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच षट्त्रिंशे त्वथ सम्प्राप्ते वर्षे कौरवनन्दनः। ददर्श विपरीतानि निमित्तानि युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, When the thirty-sixth year (after the battle) arrived, the delighter of the Kurus, viz., Yudhishthira, saw many unusual portents.

sa: पत्तिसंघान् रणे दृष्ट्वा धावमानांश्च सर्वशः। निराशा विजये सर्वे मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting, hopeless of their victory, by seeing the divisions of infantry fly with haste in all direction.

sa: अन्यत्र हि वधादेषां नास्ति राजन् पराजयः। अथ यान् रथिनो राजन् सहस्रमनुपश्यसि॥
en: They cannot be defeated unless they are slaughtered, Oking. Then again you carwarriors thousands strong in number, whom you can see.

sa: आहारः सर्वसत्त्वानि विशेषेण च तापसाः। आचारो रौद्रता नित्यं वासो मधुवने तथा॥
en: His food is every creature specially ascetics; his manner of life is regulated by ferocity and his constant home is Madhuvana.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। नित्यं शृण्वन्ति संहृष्टाः काव्यं रामायणं दिवि॥
en: There upon the celestials the Gandharvas, the great Rșis used to hear happily every day in heaven this poem of Rāmāyaṇa.

sa: ददर्श तां पिता चैव ये चैवान्ये तपस्विनः। विचेष्टमानां पतितां भूतले पद्मवर्चसम्॥
en: Her father and other ascetics, who were present, saw her lying motionless on the ground with the beauty of a lotus.

sa: ततस्ते तद् वचः श्रुत्वा ग्राह्यरूपं हलायुधात्। तूष्णीम्भूतास्ततः सर्वे साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Having heard these words of Halayudha (Baladeva) which deserved, to be accepted, they all exclaimed, “Excellent,” “Excellent.” They then became silent.

sa: उलूकोऽपि महाराज भीमं विव्याध सप्तभिः। सहदेवं च सप्तत्या परीप्सन् पितरं रणे॥
en: Uluka also, O king, desirous of rescuing his father in that battle, struck Bhima with seven arrows and Sahadeva with seventy.

sa: कच्चित् क्षितिभृतां नाथ दृष्टा सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी॥ रामा रम्ये वनोद्देशे मया विरहिता त्वया।
en: O you the best of mountains, have you beheld in this picturesque forest-land, that exquisitely fine damsel racked with my separation?

sa: अथ सम्पूज्य तद् वाक्यं मृगेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः। गोमायुः संश्रितं वाक्यं बभाषे किंचिदानतः॥
en: Honouring these words of that great lord of all animals, jackal, bending low his head a little, said these humble words.

sa: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात् परां शान्ति स्थान प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्॥
en: O Bharata, seek shelter under Him in every way. By his favour, you will get Supreme Peace and the Eternal Seat.

sa: द्रुपदः श्वशुरो येषां येषां श्यालाश्च पार्षताः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखा वीरा भ्रातरो द्रुपदात्मजाः॥ सोऽशक्यतां च विज्ञाय तेषामग्रे च भारता दायाद्यतां च धर्मेण सम्यक् तेषु समाचर॥
en: Drupada as their father-in-law and the descendant of Prishata, Drupada's Dhrishtadyumna and his other heroic brothers as their brother-in-law? O descendant of Bharata, remembering this and knowing that their claim to the kingdom is even prior to yours, behave virtuous towards them.

sa: आगम्य च ततः शक्रस्तदा राजर्षिमब्रवीत्। अलं खेदेन भवतः क्रियतां वचनं मम॥ मानवा ये निराहारा देहं त्यक्ष्यन्तन्द्रिताः। युधि वा निहता: सम्यगपि तिर्यग्गता नृप॥
en: If only by dying there men were to come to heaven, without having performed sacrifices to us, our very existence will be imperilled'Thus spoken to, Shakra returned to that royal saint and. said-Do not work any more! Act according to my words!

sa: विदिता नौ गुणा विद्वन् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। तमेव चावां मार्गावः सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्॥
en: O learned one! We knew well the accomplishments of the high-souled Sugrīva. We shall find out that king of monkey herds.

sa: कस्मिंश्चित् तु गते काले स राजा नियतव्रतः। ज्येष्ठायां धर्मचारिण्यां महिष्यां गर्भमादधे॥
en: Some time having elapsed that king observant of vows, begot offspring in the womb of his eldest queen devoted to religion.

sa: सा विग्रहवतीव श्रीळवर्धत नृपात्मजा। कालेन चापि सा कन्या यौवनस्था बभूव ह॥
en: The king's daughter (gradually) grew up like the very embodiment of Sri (Lakshmi). And that damsel, in time stepped into youth.

sa: धीत्य सर्ववेदान् वै सद्यो दुःखाद् विमुच्यते। मानसं हि चरन् धर्मं स्वर्गलोकमुपाश्नुते।।२
en: By reading all the Vedas, is immediately freed from misery, and by practising virtue in thought, one acquires the heavenly regions.

sa: ततः कालेन महता सावित्र्याः कीर्तिवर्धनम्। तद् वै पुत्रशतं जज्ञे शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्॥
en: After a long time Savitri was deliver of a hundred heroic and illustrious sons who never retreated from battle.

sa: यदि जानाति चार्वाका परिवाड् वाग्विशारदः॥ करिष्यति महाभागो ध्रुवं चापचितिं मम।
en: If Charvaka, the mendicant devotee, who is a master of speech, learns everything he will forsooth avenge my death.

sa: शिशुपालस्तु संक्रुद्धे भीमसेने जनाधिप। नाकम्पत तदा वीरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः॥
en: O king, though Bhima was angry, the heroic Shishupala, depending on his own valour, did not tremble in fear.

sa: तेन शब्देन विहगाः प्रतिबुद्धाश्च सस्वनुः। शाखास्थाः पञ्जरस्थाश्च ये राजकुलगोचराः॥ व्यहृताः पुण्यशब्दाश्च वीणानां चापि निःस्वनाः। आशीर्गेयं च गाथानां पूरयामास वेश्म तत्॥
en: And awakened by those sounds, birds on boughs and in cages worthy of the royal race, uttered notes. And the sacred words uttered by these), the notes of Vinas, and the valedictory songs of singers filled that mansion.

sa: कोऽन्यस्तां वानरी सेनां शक्तः स्तम्भयितुं भवेत्। अन्यत्र वालितन्यादन्यत्र च हनूमतः॥
en: Who save Väli's son (stationed) at one place and at another Hanumān, could be capable of stilling that force?

sa: उवाच च महादेवो दत्त्वा मेऽस्त्रं सनातनम्। न प्रयोज्यं भवेदेतन्मानुषेषु कथञ्चन॥
en: Having bestowed upon me that eternal weapon, Mahadeva said “this (weapon) shall by no means be discharged against men.

sa: अप्सरा मेनका तस्य तं गर्भं भृगुनन्दन। उत्ससर्ज यथाकालं स्थूलकेशाश्रमं प्रति॥
en: O Descendant of Bhrigu, the Apsara Menaka, when the time came, delivered her child near the herinitage of Sthulakesha.

sa: लोमपादश्च राजर्षिः शान्तां दत्त्वा सुतां प्रभुः। ऋष्यशृङ्गाय विपुलैः सर्वैः कामैरयुज्यत॥
en: The lordly Lomapada attained all the objects of his desire by giving his daughter Shanta in marriage to Rishyashringa.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहस्य विवाहे समुपस्थिते। सखीभिः क्रीडती सार्धं सा कन्या वरवर्णिनी॥
en: A few days before the date fixed for the nuptials, while the lovely girl was playing with her companions.

sa: विनीतान् वृषभान् दृष्ट्वा सहदेवस्य चाभितः। धनं ददौ बहुविधं विराटः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Beholding a herd of well-trained bullocks around Sahadeva, Virata the best of men, gave him wealth of various kinds.

sa: न क्वचित् प्राप्तपूर्वो मे संयुगेषु पराजयः॥ युष्माकमेतत् प्रत्यक्षं नानृतं कथयाम्यहम्
en: I had never before met with defeat in conflict. You have witnessed it. I do not speak a falsehood.

sa: कौरवाश्च यथा हृष्टा विनदन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः। एवं स चिन्तयित्वा तु व्याकुलेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: And as the Kurus are roaring out rapturously every moment.” Thus thinking and with a heart filled with anxiety.

sa: अथागतं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य भीमं युद्धाभिनन्दिम्। अब्रवीद् वचनं शल्यं राधेयं प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Beholding Bhima, who take delight in battle thus approach the son of Radha, as if smiling, said to Shalya.

sa: न तु तुष्यति यस्यैष पुरुषस्य दुरात्मनः। तंयमः पापकर्माणं वियातयति दुष्कृतम्॥
en: But that sinner, with whom the great Deity is not pleased, is punished by Yama for his wicked deeds.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच पूर्वमेव मया राजन्नभिप्रायमिमं तव। ज्ञात्वा पुत्रार्थमुक्तो वै भगवांस्ते पितामहः॥
en: Savitri said : Aware of your intentions before hand, I spoke about your sons to the divine Grandsire (Brahma).

sa: पश्यंस्तथैव चापश्यन् पश्यत्यन्य: सदानघ। षड्विंशं पञ्चविंशं च चतुर्विंशं च पश्यति॥
en: O sinless one, the other, seeing, sees the Nature and the Soul; not seeing, it sees the Supreme Soul.

sa: वेदयन्त्यो महाराज महद् वैशसमागतम्। दिशः प्रज्वलिता राजन् पांसुवर्ष पपात च॥
en: The points of the compass, 0 king, appeared to be blazing, and showers of bones mixed copiously with blood.

sa: सम्प्रयातानृषीन् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुर्वचनमब्रवीत्। भवन्तः क्व गमिष्यन्ति ब्रूत मे वदतां वराः॥
en: Seeing the Rishis about to start, Pandu said, "O best of eloquent men, tell me where you are going."

sa: केकया भ्रातरश्चैव स्थिता युद्धाय दंशिताः। एवं तेऽपि महाव्यूहं प्रतिव्यूह्य सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Thus the heroic Pandavas forming this mighty and invincible contrary, stood, cased in mail, prepared for the ensuing struggle.

sa: अन्तर्जानुशयो यस्तु भुङ्क्ते संसक्तभाजनः। यो द्विजः शब्दरहितं स क्षमस्तारणाय वै॥
en: The Brahmana, who eats in silence from a plate, keeping his hands between his knees, succeeds in saving others.

sa: अक्रमेण मनुष्याणां भविष्यन्ति तदा क्रियाः। विरोधमथ यास्यन्ति वृषला ब्राह्मणैः सह॥
en: Ceremonial rites of men do not follow one another in due order and the Shudras quarrel with the Brahmanas.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। अधर्मयुक्ता दुष्प्रज्ञा बाला मैषां वचः कृथाः॥
en: Duryodhana, Karna and the son of Subala, Shakuni, are sinful, foolish and young. Do not listen to their words.

sa: इदं वः सुमहच्चैव यदिहास्ति धनं मम। प्रणयन्तु भवन्तो मां यथेष्टमभिमन्त्रिताः॥
en: All this my great wealth is yours. Consult you all with one another, and guide me as you desire."

sa: नैवायोध्यां गमिष्यामो न गमिष्याम दण्डकान्। कुशलं भरतस्यास्तु रामस्यास्तु तथा सुखम्॥
en: To Ayodhyā will we not go, nor yet to Dandaka. Peace be to Bharata, and may Rāma reap happiness!

sa: एष दात्यूहको हृष्टो रम्ये मां वननिझरे। प्रणदन्मन्मथाविष्टं शोचयिष्यति लक्ष्मण ॥
en: At the pleasant fountains the delighted Dátyūahas with their warblings have been afflicting me who am possessed by Cupid.

sa: कालेयास्तु यथा राजन् सुरैः सर्वैर्निषूदिताः। अगस्त्याद् वरमासाद्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: O king, now hear how the Kalkeyas were destroyed by the celestials when they obtained their prayer from Agastya.

sa: तथैवैषा हि कल्याणी द्रौपदी शीलसम्मता। तारयिष्यति वः सर्वान् सावित्रीव कुलाङ्गना॥
en: Similarly, the auspicious Draupadi of excellent character, will deliver you all from your misfortune as the virtuous Savitri did.

sa: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता: सर्वे सहयवारणाः॥ प्राद्रवन् सहसा भीताः शकुनेश्च पदानुगाः।
en: Terrified at that roar, all the followers of Shakuni, with their horses and elephants immediately fled away in fear.

sa: जेतुं समग्रां सेनां मे वासवोऽपि न शक्नुयात्। हन्तुमक्षय्यरूपेयं ब्रह्मणोऽपि स्वयम्भुवः॥
en: To conquer my entire army, which is endless, cannot be annihilated even by Brahma, who is born of himself.

sa: प्रसादाच्चैव तस्मात् ते स्वयम्भुविहिताद् भुवि। कन्या तेजस्विनी सौम्य क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति॥
en: O virtuous one, you will, through the grace of that self-existent lord, have soon a highlyenergetic daughter on earth.

sa: अर्जुनं च शरैर्वीरः स्मयमानोऽभ्यवाकिरत्। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे पार्थः सज्यं कृत्वा महद् धनुः॥
en: And smilingly did then Drona cover Arjuna himself with many arrows. Meanwhile having strung his mighty bow, Pritha's son.

sa: दुष्यन्तस्तु तदा राजा पुत्रं शाकुन्तलं तदा। भरतं नामतः कृत्वा यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: The king Dushyanta, thereupon, installed the son of Shakuntala as his heir-apparent bestowing upon him the name of Bharata.

sa: नैनं शस्त्राणि छेत्स्यन्ति नैनं बाधिष्यते श्रमः। गावल्गणिरयं जीवन् युद्धादस्माद् विमोक्ष्यते॥
en: Wcapons will not cut him, exertion will not cxhaust him, this son of Gavalgani will return from battle alive.

sa: उत्तरं कुरुवर्षं तु समासाद्य पाण्डवः। इयेष जेतुं तं देशं पाकशासननन्दनः॥
en: Wishing to conquer that country, the son of Indra, the Pandava (Arjuna), came to the country of North Harivarsha.

sa: इच्छामि तानि चास्त्राणि द्रष्टुं दिव्यानि भारत। यैस्तथा वीर्यवन्तस्ते निवातकवचा हताः॥
en: O Bharata, (now) I wish to see those celestials weapons by means of which you destroyed the powerful Nivatakavachas.

sa: अबुध्यमानस्ता वाचो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच के भवन्तो वै किमर्थमिह तिष्ठथ॥
en: Unable to recognise the voice, Dharma's son, Yudhishthira, enquired, saying, who are you? Why also do you stay here?

sa: तेषां प्रियां प्रार्थयतो न ते भुवि गत्वा दिवं वा शरणं भविष्यति। न वर्तते कीचक ते दृशा शुभं या तेन संजीवनमर्थयेत् सा॥
en: There will be nowhere any refuge for you soliciting their beloved wife whether you go to the earth or to the heaven. O Kichaka, you have no eyes that may win for you any good or safety of your life.

sa: शूलं भग्नं हनुमता दृष्ट्वा वानरवाहिनी। हृष्टा ननाद बहुशः सर्वतश्चापि दुद्रुवे॥
en: Seeing the dart severed by Hanumān, the monkey-army, growing delighted, set up countless shouts and rushed in all directions.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं स्तुतस्तदा देवः कृष्णया भक्तवत्सलः। द्रौपद्याः संकटं ज्ञात्वा देवदेवो जगत्पतिः॥ पार्श्वस्थां शयने त्यक्त्वा रुक्मिणी केशवः प्रभुः। तत्राजगाम त्वरितो ह्यचिन्त्यगतिरीश्वरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then thus eulogised by Krishna the lord, fond of his votaries, the god of gods, the lord of the universe, Kesava of mysterious movements, percieving Draupadi's difficulty and leaving Rukmani on the bed him, came there quickly.

sa: वध्यमानं बलं दृष्ट्वा युयुधानेन मारिष। अभ्यद्रवत् स्वयं द्रोणः सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्॥
en: Then, O sire, beholding the troops slaughtered by Yuyudhana, Drona himself assailed Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled.

sa: मया विरहितां दीनां वर्तमानां महावने। वैदहीं प्रसभं हृत्वा शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे॥
en: Having forcibly carried away Vaidehi staying in that mighty forest, forlorn and without me, you think, 'I am hero.'

sa: विहीनांश्च कृतानश्वान् विस्थांश्च कृतान् नरान्। तत्र सात्यकिपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting seeing steeds deprived of riders and warriors deprived of chariots, by Arjuna and Satyaki.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अजातशत्रोर्वचनं तच्छ्रुत्वा तु धनंजयः। प्रतिजज्ञे गुरोर्वाक्यं कौरवाणां विमोक्षणम्॥
en: Having heard these words of Ajatshatru, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) at the command of his Guru, vowed to rescue the Kurus.

sa: प्रतियुद्धे तु नियतः स्यादस्माकं पराजयः। युधिष्ठिरस्य सर्वे हि पार्थिवा वशवर्तिनः॥
en: In a fight against them, defeat shall surely be ours; all the rulers are on the side of Yudhishthira.

sa: निर्जित्य त रणे कर्ण भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। ननाद बलवान् नादं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: Then the valiant Bhima, having defeated Karna uttered a loud war-cry, that resembled the roar of the rain-cloud Parjannya.

sa: स्नुषाभिः प्रस्नुषाभिश्च वृद्धो राजा पिता मम॥ गान्धारीसहितश्चैव कां गतिं प्रतिपत्स्यति।
en: Alas, what shall be the condition of the old king, my father, with Gandhari, and his daughter-in-law and grand-daughter-in-law!

sa: शशाप ज्वलनः सर्वान् द्विरदान् क्रोधमूच्छितः॥ प्रतीपा भवतां जिह्वा भवित्रीति भृगूद्वह।
en: Worked up with anger, Agni cursed all the elephants, O descendent of Bhrigu, sayingYour tongues will be bent back.

sa: स्पर्धते स स्म सततं देवराजेन नित्यदा। वासवोऽपि मरुत्तेन स्पर्धते पाण्डुनन्दन॥
en: He always used to defy the king of the celestials; and, O son of Pandu, Vasava also defied Marutta.

sa: क्व च तत् साम्प्रतं द्रव्यं भगवन्नवतिष्ठते। कथं च शक्यमस्माभिस्तदवाप्तुं तपोधन॥
en: And where now, O reverend sire, is all his wealth? And, O ascetic, how can we secure the same?

sa: स्थावराणां तु भूतानां सर्वेषामविशेषतः। ब्रह्मक्षेत्रं सदा पुण्यं प्लक्षः प्रथमतः स्मृतः॥
en: Of all immobile objects without distinction, Plaksha is said to be the first, that ever holy field of Brahman.

sa: दुर्लभं सलिलं तात विशेषेण परत्र वै। पानीयस्य प्रदानेन प्रीतिर्भवति शाश्वती॥
en: Water, especially in the other world, is difficult to get, O son. A gift of drink yields eternal happiness.

sa: ततः सोऽभ्यद्रवद् देवान् रुद्रो रौद्रपराक्रमः। भगस्य नयने क्रुद्धः प्रहारेण व्यशातयत्॥
en: Meanwhile, Rudra of terrible prowess rushed against the celestials. Filled with anger, he tore out the eyes of Bhaga.

sa: वाराहं रूपमास्थाय हिरण्याक्षो निपातितः। वामनं रूपमास्थाय जितो राजा मया बलिः॥
en: Assuming the forin of a boar I killed Hiranyaksha. Assuming the form of a dwarf I conquered king Bali.

sa: तस्य द्वाराणि सर्वाणि पर्याप्तानि बृहन्ति च। सर्वतः सुविभक्तानि यन्त्रैरारक्षितानि च॥
en: The gates should all be large and sufficiently strong. Kept in proper places, those gates should be carefully guarded.

sa: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा चक्षुषा चैव ते नृप। संनियम्येन्द्रियग्राममास्थिते परमं तपः॥
en: Restraining their senses in thought, words, and deeds, as well as by cye, they began to perforin sever austerities.

sa: त्रिशिरास्तस्य दिव्यश्च शातकुम्भमयो द्रुमः । ध्वजस्तृणेन्द्रो देवस्य भविष्यति रथाश्रितः ॥
en: Upon the car of that divine person a tall palmyra, three-headed and made of gold, will be his standard.

sa: चम्पकांस्तिलकान् भव्यान् पनसान् वञ्जुलानपि। पुष्पितान् कर्णिकारांश्च तत्र तत्र ददर्श ह॥
en: And he saw there many Champakas and Tilakas and Bhavyas and Panasas and Vyanjulas and Karnikaras adorned with flowers.

sa: ततो मे ब्राह्मणास्तुष्टास्तस्मिन् कर्मणि साधिते। सहस्रमृषयश्चासन् ये वै तत्र समागताः॥
en: When I finished that very superior vow, the Brahmanas became all pleased with me. A thousand Rishis came there.

sa: ततस्ते सत्वरा जग्मुः पितुर्दर्शनकाक्षिणः। सहदेवस्तु वेगेन प्राधावद् यत्र सा पृथा।॥
en: Desirous of meeting with their sire they walked rapidly. Then Sahadeva ran quickly towards the spot where Pritha was.

sa: ये चापि पृथिवीपाला: समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः। उपातिष्ठन्त ते सर्वे कौरवेन्द्रं यथा पुरा॥
en: Those kings who came there one after another, all used to wait upon the old Kuru king as before.

sa: प्राङ्मुखः सह गान्धार्या कुन्त्या चोपाविशत् तदा। संजयस्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा प्रदक्षिणमथाकरोत्॥
en: Facing the east, he sat down, with Gandhari and Kunti. Seeing him in that attitude Sanjaya walked round him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा कृष्णस्तपोवननिवासिभिः। मानयामास तान् सर्वानृषीन् देवकिनन्दनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by those hermits' Krishna, the delighter of Devaki, paid due honors to all those Rishis.

sa: ततः संधाय ते सर्वे वाक्यान्यथ समासतः। एकस्मिन् ब्राह्मणे राजन् निवेश्योचुनराधिपम्॥
en: Setting their words briefly, O king, they charged a certain Brahmana therewith and thus replied to the old king.

sa: इत्युक्तस्तु तदा राजा ब्राह्मणेन यशस्विना। मुहुरुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य न किंचित् प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Thus addressed by that celebrated Brahmana, the king, hearing repeated and hou sighs, said not a word in reply.

sa: अमृतं चैव पानाय दत्तमस्मै पुरा विभो। महात्मना तदर्थं च नास्माभिर्विनिपात्यते॥
en: Formerly, O lord, nectar was given by Brahman to Nahusha for drinking. Therefore we can do nothing to him.

sa: अयं च कौरवो राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ सर्वैर्भवद्भिर्द्रष्टव्यः समेपु विपमेषु च।
en: This Kuru king, Yudhishthira the son of Kunti, should be looked after by you all, in weal and woe.

sa: तस्य दुःखपरीतस्य स्वं पुत्रमनुशोचतः। व्यतीतं तदहःशेषं सा चोग्रा तत्र शर्वरी॥
en: Filled with grief as he bewailed for his son, the rest of that day passed away and night came.

sa: सेनापते यथा ते स्युः कृतविद्याश्चतुर्विधाः । योधा नगररक्षायां तथा व्यादेष्टुमर्हसि॥
en: O general, it behove you so to order the disciplined fourfold forces that they may successfully protect the city.

sa: ननु नाम महाबाहो तव वैश्रवणानुज। क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं त्रस्यत्यपि पुरंदरः॥
en: O you of huge arms! O younger brother of Baishravana! Even Purandara feared to stand before you when enraged.

sa: ततः संस्मारितो रामस्तेन वाक्येन मातलेः। जग्राह स शरं दीप्तं निःश्वसन्तमिवोरगम्॥
en: Being reminded by those words of Mätali, Rāma took up the flaming shaft breathing as if like a serpent.

sa: तया धर्षणया कुद्धो मातलेन तथात्मनः॥ चकार शरजालेन राघवो विमुखं रिपुम्।
en: Beholding his charioteer thus assailed Rāma was excited with wrath and overwhelmed his foe with a net of arrows.

sa: सव्रणैः प्रथमं गात्रैरिदानी निव्रणैः समैः। ततः समुत्थिता सर्वे सुप्त्वेव हरिसत्तमाः॥
en: Thereupon all these leading monkeys who had their persons wounded but now healed up, rose up like those asleep.

sa: रक्षसां रावणं चापि वानराणां च राघवम्। पश्यतां विस्मिताक्षाणां सैन्यं चित्रमिवाबभौ॥
en: The Rakşasas beholding Rāvana, and the monkeys beholding Rāma with wonder-stricken eyes, the whole army appeared like a picture.

sa: समीक्ष्य च महाबाहो राघवस्य पराक्रमम्। लक्ष्मणस्य च विक्रान्तमभवत् प्रीतिमान् कपिः॥
en: Having witnessed the prowess of Rāghava, as well as the vigour of Lakşmaņa, the monkey was filled with joy.

sa: रावणश्च यतस्तत्र प्रचचाल वसुंधरा। रक्षसां च प्रहरतां गृहीता इव बाहवः॥
en: And wherever Rāvana moved the earth shook an the hands of all the Rākşasas fighting were as if paralysed.

sa: इत्युक्तः संपरिक्रम्य रथं तमभिवाद्य च। आरुरोह तदा रामो लोकॉल्लक्ष्म्या विराजयन्॥
en: Thus addressed, Rāma, going round the car and saluting it, ascended the same, illumining the worlds with his splendour.

sa: ततः स हरिशार्दूलो लङ्कया ताडितो भृशम्। ननाद सुमहानादं वीर्यवान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: That tiger-like monkey, the energetic offspring of the wind-god, on being lustily struck by Larkā, emitted a tremendous roars.

sa: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना। आहूय चाब्रवीत्सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, Tårā, having a perfectly beautiful person, assembling all the wives of the monkeys, said.

sa: इमां त्वविषमां लङ्कां दुर्गा रावणपालिताम्। प्राप्यापि सुमहाबाहुः किं करिष्यति राघवः॥
en: Even if the mighty-armed Rāghava should reach this terrible-looking and impregnable Lankā reared by Rāvana, what could he do?

sa: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना। आहूय चाब्रवीत्सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, Tårā, having a perfectly beautiful person, assembling all the wives of the monkeys, said.

sa: रावणस्याप्रसह्यं तं शरसंपातमेकतः। न शेकुः सहितुं दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा॥
en: As the flies cannot stand before the flaming fire so they could not bear the vehemence of Ravana's shafts.

sa: ते तु हृष्टाभिनर्दन्तो भिन्दन्त इव मेदिनीम्। नादं घोरं विमुञ्चन्तो निर्ययुर्जयकाङ्गिणः॥
en: They, desirous of winning victory, issued out emitting dreadful roars in delight and as if rending the earth therewith.

sa: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न च द्यौर्नापि सागराः। प्रकाशत्वं गमिष्यन्ति मद्वाणजलदावृताः॥
en: The atmosphere, the quarters the sky and the deep being enveloped with the cloud of arrows shall become invisible.

sa: इतीव सर्वा रजनीचरस्त्रियः परस्परं संपरिरभ्य बाहुभिः। विषेदुरार्तातिभयाभिपीडिता विनेदुरुच्चैश्च तदा सुदारुणम्॥
en: Thus bewailed piteously and loudly-the she demons holding each other by neck and being stricken with fear and grief.

sa: चुक्रुशुस्ते ततः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः। हृष्यन्ते निहते तस्मिन्देवा वृत्रवधे यथा॥
en: Then all the monkeys with Vibhīşaņa set up cheers, even as the immortals cheered at the destruction of Vrtra.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिंजयः।। आग्नेयं संदधे दीप्तं सलोकं संक्षिपन्निव। ५६॥
en: Then, waxing wroth, that victor in battle-the wondrous energetic Indrajit—as if annihilating the world, discharged a flaming Angeya weapon.

sa: रामो मातरमासाद्य विवर्णां शोककर्शिताम्। जग्राह प्रणतः पादौ मनो मातुः प्रहर्षयन्।॥
en: Having approached his mother, pale and pulled down with grief, Rāma humbly touched her feet and enhanced her delight.

sa: अवेक्षतां भवान्कोशं कोष्ठागारं गृहं बलम्। भवतस्तेजसा सर्वं कृतं दशगुणं मया।५६।।
en: Do you examine your wealth treasury, palace and army. By your favour I have increased all these ten fold.

sa: श्वेतं च बालव्यजनं जगृहे परितः स्थितः। अपरं चन्द्रसंकाशं राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः॥
en: Vibhīşaņa, the lord of Rākşasas standing on one side, took up the white Chowrie shining like the second moon.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भरतः सत्यविक्रमः। हस्ते गृहीत्वा सुग्रीवं प्रविवेश तमालयम्॥
en: Hearing those words, Bharata, having truth for his prowess, taking Sugrīva by the hand, conducted him to the palace.

sa: तौ तस्य शरवेगेन परीतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। धनुषी सशरे कृत्वा दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रचक्रतुः॥
en: Being hurt with the arrows, Rāma and Lakş mana, fixing arrows on their bows, began to discharge celestial shafts.

sa: तेन चादित्यकल्पने ब्रह्मास्त्रेण च पालितः। स बभूव दुराधर्षो रावणिः सुमहाबलः॥
en: Being thus well protected with Brahma weapons resembling the Sun in brilliance, the mighty son of Rāvana became invincible.

sa: भगवन्तः कुंभकर्णं रावणं च निशाचरम्। अतिक्रम्य महावीयौँ किं प्रशंसथ रावणिम्॥
en: You worshipful ones, wherefore, passing by those exceedingly powerful ones-Kumbhakarna and the night-ranger, Ravana, do you praise Ravana's son?

sa: गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलम्। आजधान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः॥
en: And finding his brother taken, the highly energetic Soạitākṣa then dealt the mighty Dvivida a blow in the chest.

sa: शस्त्राणि शरपत्राणि समिधोऽथ बिभीतकाः। लोहितानि च वासांसि स्रुवं कार्णायसं तथा॥
en: Arms served for Kasa and Bibhitakas for fuel; and there were red cloths and a ladle made black iron.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा घोरसंकाशां शक्तिं भग्नां हनूमता। प्रहृष्टा वानरगणा विनेदुर्जलदा यथा॥
en: Seeing that dreadful dart broken by Hanumān, the monkeys, transported with delignt, sent up shouts, even as clouds rumble.

sa: नेह पश्यामि लोकेऽन्यं यो मे प्रतिबलो भवेत्। पश्य मे सुमहद्वीर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वमाहवे॥
en: Find I none on this earth who can withstand my prowess. Do you behold my matchless prowess in battle.

sa: ततः सुमाली माली च श्रुत्वा माल्यवतो वचः। ऊचतुर्भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठमश्विनाविव वासवम्॥
en: Thereat Sumāli and Māli, hearing the words of Malyavān, said to their eldest brother, like the Asvins addressing Vāsava.

sa: सा मही रुधिरौधेण प्रच्छन्ना संप्रकाशते। संछन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैरिव पुष्पितैः॥
en: The earth drenched with streams of gore looked as if swarming with blossoming palāśas in the month of spring.

sa: तमापतन्तं संक्रुद्धं राक्षसानां भयावहम्। ददर्शाकम्पनो वीरश्चक्षोभ च ननाद च ॥
en: Seeing that one enraged, terrific to the Rāks asas, the heroic Akampana was agitated greatly and sent up shouts.

sa: तं गृहीत्वा महास्कन्धं सोऽश्वकर्णं महाद्युतिः। प्रगृह्य परया प्रीत्या भ्रामयामास भूतले॥
en: And taking that broad-shouldered Asvakarma, that one furnished with high splendour, with great glee whirled it above the ground.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसेश्वरः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनाम्॥
en: Hearing those harsh accents, that lord of Rākṣasas, replied to Sītā, of comely presence, with the following unpleasant words.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य रोषेण गदां तां बहुकण्टकाम्। पातयामास धूम्राक्षो मस्तकेऽथ हनूमतः॥
en: Then Dhūmrākṣa enraged, brought down that mace studded with innumerable pricks, on the head of Hanumān fired with wrath.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुपर्णः शीघ्रविक्रमः। रामं च नीरुनं कृत्वा मध्ये तेषां वनौकसाम्॥ प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा परिष्वज्य च वीर्यवान्। जगामाकाशमाविश्य सुपर्णः पवनो यथा।६।।
en: Having spoken thus, Suparna, endowed with vigour, having rendered Rāma hale in the midst of the monkeys, having gone round them and embrace them also, that one possessed of prowess, set out, covering up the sky, like to the wind.

sa: अनेन रूपेण मया न शक्या रक्षसां पुरी। प्रवेष्टुं राक्षसैर्गुप्ता क्रूरैर्बलसमन्वितैः॥
en: I cannot in this form succeed in entering the city of the Rākşasas, guarded by wily and powerful Rākṣasas.

sa: अस्मदीया च लङ्केयं नगरी राक्षसोषिता। निवेशिता तव भ्रात्रा धनाध्यक्षेण धीमता॥
en: This Lankā was our city, inhabited by Rākşasas. (Now) it is inhabited by the brotherthe intelligent lord of riches.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वसन्तं रावणं ततः॥ प्रहस्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमिदमाह स रावणम्।
en: It came to pass that when Rāvana had resided there for a time, Prahasta addressed him in humble speech.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मज्ञौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। निर्बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः प्रजहर्ष ननाद च॥
en: Having spoken thus to the brothers-Rāma and Laksmana, cognizant of righteousness-(Indrajit)pierced them with sharpened shafts, and shouted in joy.

sa: तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा। लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ॥
en: With that sound the entire Lankā, with her wall and gateways, her mountains, woods, and forests, began to shake.

sa: पाण्डुरा रक्तपादाश्च विहगाः कालचोदिताः। राक्षसानां विनासाय कपोता विचरन्ति च ॥
en: are And red-footed white sky-coursing pigeons, urged on by Doom, are going about for the destruction of the Raksasas.

sa: अचितं सततं यत्नाद्गन्धमाल्यैर्मया तव। इदं ते मत्प्रियं वीर धनुः काञ्चनभूषितम्॥
en: Ever carefully worshipped with perfumed wreaths, this bow of your, O hero, embellished with gold, is dear to me.

sa: गदेयं मामिका नैनं संयुगेषु बधिष्यति। इत्येवं धनदः प्राह तदा ह्येकाक्षिपिङ्गिलः॥
en: This mace of mine will not cause his death. So was said by Kubera endowed with one brown eye.

sa: वालिनः सदृशः पुत्रः सुग्रीवस्य सदा प्रियः। राघवार्थे पराक्रान्तः शक्रार्थे वरुणो यथा॥ एतस्य सा मतिः सर्वा यदृष्टा जनकात्मजा। हनूमता वेगवता राघवस्य हितैषिणा॥
en: The worthy son of Vālī and ever dear to Sugrīva, he puts forth his prowess, as Varuņa does for Sakra. That that well-wished of Rāghava, the vehement Hanumān, has seen Janaka's daughter, was owing to the advice of this one.

sa: पुरा प्राकारमायान्ति क्षिप्रमेकतरं कुरु। सीतां चास्मै प्रयच्छाशु युद्धं वापि प्रदीयताम्॥
en: They advance before the wall. Speedily do one of these things-make over Sītā without delay, or give (him) battle.

sa: इति दाशरथी रामो लक्ष्मणं समभाषत। बलं च तत्र विभजच्छास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: Having divided his forces there agreeably to the directions of the scriptures, Dasaratha's son, Rāma, thus spoke to Laksmana.

sa: तं तु वेदविदा तेन लम्बाभरणशोभिना। वायुमुत्थाप्य हस्तेन शिशुं तं परिमृष्टवान्॥
en: The knower of the Vedas lifted up the Vāyu with his outstretched and adorned hands and embraced the child.

sa: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तं च दृष्ट्वा महाशरम्। महोदधिर्महातेजा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Rāma's speech, and looking at the mighty arrow, that exceedingly energetic one, the great Deep, addressed Raghava, saying.

sa: त्वं हि सत्यव्रतः शूरो धार्मिको दृढविक्रमः। परीक्ष्यकारी स्मृतिमानिसृष्टात्मा सुहृत्सु च।३६।।
en: You are of truthful vows, heroic, pious, of firm prowess, discriminating, recollecting and having implicit confidence in your friends.

sa: जानामि शीलं ज्ञातीनां सर्वलोकेषु राक्षस। हृष्यन्ति व्यसनेष्वेते ज्ञातीनां ज्ञातयः सदा॥
en: I know well the nature of kinsmen, in all the worlds, O Raksasas, one takes delight in another's misfortune.

sa: यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति। पूर्वं चापरकार्याणि स न वेद नयानयौ ॥
en: He does not know what is proper and what not, that performs prior actions afterwards, and posterior actions first.

sa: सुलोहिततलौ श्लक्ष्णौ चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठितौ। दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखौ तस्या दीप्यते मे शरीरजः॥
en: And beholding her dainty and tender fect with roseate soles, and having coppery nails, my mind burn (with desire).

sa: अयं हि सुप्तः षण्मासान्कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः। सर्वशस्त्रभृतां मुख्यः स इदानीं समुत्थित॥
en: After having slept for six months that one of prodigious strength, foremost of those bearing arms, has just risen.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धा वरुणस्य महात्मनः। पुत्राः पौत्राश्च निष्क्रामन्गौश्च पुष्कर एव च॥
en: In the meantime the sons and grandsons of the high-souled Varuņa, as well as those of Puskara issued forth.

sa: ततो निकुम्भो रभसः सूर्यशत्रुर्महाबलः। सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च महापार्श्वमहोदरौ॥ अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसाः। इन्द्रशत्रुश्च बलवांस्ततो वै रावणात्मजः॥ प्रहस्तोऽथ विरूपाक्षो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः। धूम्राक्षोऽथ निकुम्भश्च दुर्मुखश्चैव राक्षसः॥ परिघान्पट्टिशाञ्छूलान्प्रासाशक्तिपरश्वधान्। चापानि च सुबाणानि खङ्गांश्च विपुलाम्बुभान्॥ प्रगृह्य परमक्रुद्धाः समुत्पत्य च राक्षसाः। अब्रुवन्रावणं सर्वे प्रदीप्ता इव तेजसा॥ अद्य रामं वधिष्यामः सुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम्। कृपणं च हनूमन्तं लङ्का येन प्रधर
en: Then, in fierce wrath seizing bludgeons, and pattiśas, lances and bearded darts and javelins, and axes, bows and excellent shafts and swords, resembling crystalline water, sprung up the Rākşasas, Rabhasa, and the mighty Sūryasatru, and Saptaghna, and Yajñakopa, and Mahāpārsva and Mahodra, Agniketu the irrepressible, and the Rākṣasa Rasmiketu, and the lusty Indraśatru, son to Ravana-and Prahasta, Virupaksa, and the exceedingly strong Vajradanstra, and Dhumrākşa, and Nikumbha, and the Rākşasa Durmukha. And, flaming in energy, they all addressed Ravana, To-day shall we slay Rāma, and Sugrīva along with Lakşmaņa, and the helpless Hanumān, who has damaged Lankā.

sa: आगतस्तु पथा येन तेनैव विनिवृत्य सः। लङ्कामभिमुखो रक्षो नभस्तलगतो ययौ।॥
en: And returning by the way by which he had come the Raksasa, stationed in the welkin, proceeded towards Lankā.

sa: ततो वानरराजेन लक्ष्मणेन सुपूजितः।॥ जगाम रामो धर्मात्मा ससैन्यो दक्षिणां दिशम्।
en: Then well honoured by Sugrīva and Laks maņa, the righteous Rāma proceeded towards the South, accompanied by his army.

sa: तस्य दाशरथे: पार्श्वे शूरास्ते कपिकुञ्जराः॥ तूर्णमापुप्लुवुः सर्वे सदश्वा इव चोदिताः।
en: At the side of Daſaratha's son those heroic monkeys resembling elephants, proceeded by bounds, like noble horses, spurred on.

sa: अनेन रात्रिशेषेण यदि नाश्वास्यते मया। सर्वथा नास्ति संदेहः परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥
en: If I do not console her at this later end of the night, surely shall she renounce her life.

sa: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे। किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वर॥
en: O you foremost of those skilled in speech, what had you settled about the accomplishment of this hard work?

sa: तं मां शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम्। दृष्ट्वा च परिधावन्तं भवेयुः परिशङ्किताः॥
en: Beholding me leap from branch to branch and trunk to trunk of big trees they shall be greatly alarmed.

sa: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मजः। तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा रुरोद सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, placing that jewel on his breast, wept with Laksmana.

sa: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम्॥ काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषित्तद्वचो मम।
en: I related to him everything truly. But being possessed by lust he did not pay heed to my, words.

sa: ततोऽहं सुमहदूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः। विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon contracting again my huge person and relieving myself of the fetters I stood again in my pristine state.

sa: स किंचिदारात् सम्प्राप्तः समालोक्य महागिरिम्॥ महेन्द्र मेघसंकाशं ननाद स महाकपिः।
en: And from a distance approaching and beholding that mighty mountain, Mahendra, resembling clouds, that redoubted monkey began to roar.

sa: सहितौ रामसुग्रीवावुभावकुरुतां तदा। समयं वालिनं हन्तुं तव चान्वेषणं प्रति ॥
en: Thus Rāma and Sugrīva entered into a friendly covenant, to encompass Vali's destruction and to institute enquiries about you.

sa: तस्मिन्यद्यसमाप्ते च जप्यहोमे विभावसौ। युध्येयं देव संग्रामे तदा मे स्याद्विनाशनम्॥
en: May I meet with destruction, O deity, whenever I shall engage in fight without finishing my offerings to fire.

sa: स सालवृक्षमासाद्य समुत्पाट्य च वानरः। तावुभौ राक्षसौ वीरौ जघान पवनात्मजः॥
en: Then getting at and uprooting a sāla tree, that monkey, the Wind-god's offspring, slew both of those heroic Rākşasas.

sa: विसृजन्तो महाकाया मारुतिं पर्यवारयन्। ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः॥ आजग्मुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं बाणैश्चादित्यसंनिभैः।
en: They encountered that foremost of monkeys with various maces, and axes, and golden Angadas, and arrows resembling the Sun.

sa: उत्तस्थापि तं वीरं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः। चेदिराट् समरे राजन्नुलूकं समभिद्रवत्॥
en: Uttara also wounded him with many sharp arrows; O king, the ruler of Chedi attacked in that battle Uluka.

sa: अस्वस्ति तस्य कुर्वन्ति देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः। यः सहायान् परित्यज्य स्वस्तिमानाव्रजेद् गृहम्॥
en: The gods headed by Shakra himself visit him with evil who abandoning his supporters in battle, returns home unscathed.

sa: तेषां शैलोपमैः कायैर्निपतद्भिः समन्ततः। आहता सहसा भूमिश्चकम्पे च ननाद च॥
en: Struck with the falling carcasses of elephants huge like large mountains, the earth suddenly quaked and emitted loud sound.

sa: स्त्रीलिङ्गं धारयामास स्थूणायक्षोऽथ भारत। यक्षरूप च तद् दीप्ते शिखण्डी प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: The Yaksha Sthuna took upon himself (her) maidenhood, O Bharata, and Shikhandin obtained the blazing form of the Yaksha.

sa: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म तं नृपम्। पूजाभिः स्वागताधाभिरासनेनोदकेन च॥
en: Then did all those ascetics worship that ruler of men and welcome him with their greetings, seat and water.

sa: ततो रथं समारुह्य स्तूयमानो द्विजातिभिः। प्रविश्य नगरं मात्रे सत्यवत्यै न्यवेदयम्॥
en: Thereupon, sending my chariot, and praised by the twice-born, I entered the city and immediately informed Satyavati, my mother,

sa: योगिनं तं महात्मानं प्रविष्टं मानुषीं तनुम्। अवमन्येद् वासुदेवं तमाहुस्तामसं जनाः॥
en: He is spoken of as a great sinner who disregards Vasudeva for his having incarnated himself as a man.

sa: नरानेव नरा जघ्नुरुदग्राश्च हया हयान्। रथांश्च रथिनो जनुर्वारणा वरवारणान्॥ समवर्तत॥
en: Men slew men and mettled steeds slew other steeds and car-warriors slew car-warriors and mighty elephants slew other elephant.

sa: भो भोः कौरवदायाद सहास्माभिर्महाबल। एहि युध्यस्व संग्रामे समस्तैः पृथगेव वा॥
en: "O kinsman of the Kauravas, O mighty one, come give us battle; fight with us either jointly or separately.

sa: ते किरीटिनमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा हर्षेण मारिष। उदक्रोशन् नरव्याघ्राः शब्देन महता तदा॥
en: O Sire, seeing the diadem-decked Arjuna rush at them, those foremost of men, highly delighted, gave out deafening roars.

sa: एवं तां भाषमाणां तु कन्यां शाल्वपतिस्तदा। परितत्याज कौरव्य करुणं परिदेवतीम्॥
en: At that time the lord of the Shalvas thus abandoned that girl, O Kaurava, who spoke to him plaintively.

sa: स लक्ष्मणस्येष्वसनं छित्त्वा लक्ष्म च भारत। लक्ष्मणे शरजालानि विसृजन् बबशोभत॥
en: But the latter, O Bharata, appeared resplendent, having cut-off Lakshmana's bow and banner-mark and showering myriad shafts on him.

sa: सहस्रशो महाशब्दः शिखराणि पतन्ति च। महाभूता भूमिकम्पे चत्वारः सागराः पृथक्।
en: Thousands of sounds are heard thousands of mountain-summits are falling down. Earth trembles, and in consequence the four oceans.

sa: अभिमन्युश्च तां वाचं कद कृत्य सारथः॥ याहीत्येवाब्रवीदेन द्रोणानीकाय मा चिरम्।
en: Thereafter Abhimanyu seeing at naught those words of his charioteer commanded him saying-"Quickly drive towards the division of Drona."

sa: सौमदत्तिं तथा शूरमार्थ्यशृङ्गिं च राक्षसम्। त्रिगर्तराजं च रणे सह सर्वैर्महारथैः॥
en: The valiant of Somadatta, the Rakshasa, Alambusha, and the ruler of the Trigarta's along with all the mighty car-warriors,

sa: हयानां हेषमाणानां योधानां चैव गर्जताम्। क्षणेनैव नभो भूमिः शब्देनापूरितं तदा॥
en: The sky and the earth were soon filled with the neighing of horses and the shouts of the soldiers.

sa: सर्वे त्वन्ये महीपालाः प्रेक्षका इव भारत। ददृशुर्दर्शनीयं तं भीमं ज्ञातिसमागमम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, all the kings stood like spectators and saw the interesting and awful battle between kinsmen.

sa: समास्थाय मतिं वीरो बीभत्सुः शत्रुतापनः। कृपां चक्रे रथश्रेष्ठो भारद्वाजसुतं प्रति॥
en: Thinking thus, that grinder of enemies the brave Bibhatsu (Arjuna) that foremost of carwarriors, showed mercy towards Bharadvaja's son.

sa: स निर्भिन्नः शरैोरैर्भुजगैः कोपितैरिव। अलम्बुषो भृशं राजन् नागेन्द्र इव चुक्रुधे॥
en: Thus pierced by those dreadful arrows resembling furious snakes, Alambusha, O king, became infuriated like a prince of elephants.

sa: विविशुस्ते तदा हृष्टा गान्धारा युद्धदुर्मदाः। तान् प्रविष्टांस्तदा दृष्ट्वा इरावानपि वीर्यवान्॥
en: Those Gandhara heroes formidable in battle cheerfully penetrated into it. Thereupon the highly puissant Iravat, beholding them very delightful,

sa: कृतदारः शिखण्डी च काम्पिल्यं पुनरागमत्। ततः सा वेद तां कन्या कञ्चित् कालं स्त्रियं किल॥१३ हिरण्यवर्मणः कन्या ज्ञात्वा तां तु शिखण्डिनीम्।
en: as was And Shikandin, being wedded, returned to Kampilya. And then after a certain time she (daughter of Hiranyavarma) came to know her to be a woman. And the daughter of Hiranyavarman, knowing Shikhandin to be a woman,

sa: तत्र भारत भीष्मस्य रणे दृष्ट्वा पराक्रमम्। अत्यद्भुतमपश्याम शक्रस्येव पराक्रमम्॥ तथैव भीमसेनस्य पार्षतस्य च भारत। रौद्रमासीद् रणे युद्ध सात्यकस्य च धन्विनः॥
en: In that battle, O Bharata, we beheld the prowess of Bhishma, of Bhimasena and also, O Bharata, of the son of Prishata. The battle that mighty bowmen of the Satvata race namely Satyaki, fought, was indeed very fierce.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽपि नृपतिः परिवार्य महारणे। भीष्मं शान्तनवं तूर्णं प्रयात: शिबिरं प्रति॥
en: In that great battle also, king Duryodhana surrounding Bhishma the son of Shantanu, speedily proceed towards his own tents.

sa: एवं ते समयं कृत्वा कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः प्रेक्षमाणाः परस्परम्॥
en: Having made these agreements, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas, staring at one another were filled with surprise.

sa: भीष्मस्य पतितं केतुं दृष्ट्वा तालं महात्मनः। ततो दुर्योधनः क्रोधात् स्वमनीकमनोदयत्।।६
en: Seeing the palmyra-standard of the illustrious Bhishma cut down, Duryodhana, in great anger, urged his army to the battle.

sa: सौभद्रस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पातिते रथसारथौ। बृहद्वलं महाराज विव्याध नवभिः शरैः॥
en: When his charioteer was overthrown, Subhadra's son was filled with wrath. O king, be pierced Brihadbala with nine arrows.

sa: अद्य सप्ताष्टदिवसान् डिण्डिकोऽपि न दृश्यते॥ एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचः सर्वे मूषिका विप्रदुद्रुवुः।
en: For these seven and eight days moreover Dindika too is not seen.' Hearing this all the mice ran away.

sa: प्रयुक्ता रथिभिर्बाणा भीमवेगाः सुतेजनाः। ते निपेतुर्महाराज नागेषु च रथेषु च॥
en: Fleet arrows charged with energy and shot by car-warriors, O mighty monarch, began to fall on elephants and chariots.

sa: अनादृत्य ततो भीष्मस्तं शिखण्डिनमाहवे। प्रययौ सुंजयान् क्रुद्धः स्त्रीत्वं चिन्त्य शिखण्डिनः॥
en: Then Bhishma remembering the femininity of Shikhandin, and for that reason neglecting him in battle, rushed against the Srinjayas.

sa: शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि द्रोणं प्रति जनेश्वर॥
en: O king, having seen his dart thus baffled, and greatly powerful Dhrishtadyumna poured a shower of arrows on Drona.

sa: शिरांसि रथिनां भीष्मः पातयामास संयुगे। तालेभ्यः परिपक्वानि फलानि कुशलो नरः॥
en: Then in that battle Bhishma felled the heads of car-warriors like expert men felling ripe palm-fruits from their trees.

sa: तथैवान्याश्च दृश्यन्ते स्त्रियो वै ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। वैनतेयान् मयूरांश्च जनयन्ति पुरे तव॥
en: O king, the wives of many Brahmavadins in your city are seen to give birth to Garuda's and pea-cocks.

sa: एकीभूतास्ततः सर्वे कुरवः सह पाण्डवैः। अयुध्यन्त महाराज मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे॥
en: When the sun reached the meridian, O mighty sovereign, the Kurus mingling pell-mell with the Pandavas fought on fiercely.

sa: संयम्य तु ततो द्रोणः समवस्थाप्य चाहवे॥ स्वमनीकं महेष्वासः पार्षतं समुपाद्रवत्।
en: Thereupon Drona of mighty arms, again rallying has soldiers and re-arranging them, charged the son of Prishata in battle.

sa: जीवितं दुस्त्यजं त्यक्त्वा भयं च सुमहाहवे॥ पातयामास सैन्यानि पाण्डवानां विशाम्पते।
en: O kind, reckless of his own life, abandoning all fear, he slaughtered the Pandava troops in that great battle.

sa: तेजसाल्पेन संयुक्ताः क्रोधनाः पुरुषा नृप। लुब्धा अनृतकाश्चैव तिष्ये जायन्ति भारत॥
en: O king, the men born in the Kali Yuga possess little energy. They become highly wrathful, covetous and untruthful.

sa: शल्यो भूरिश्रवाश्चैव पुरुमित्रो जयस्तथा। अश्वत्थामा कृपो द्रोणो द्यूतं नेच्छन्ति संजय!॥
en: O Sanjaya, so also, Shalya Bhurishravas, Purumitra. Jaya, Ashvatthaman, Kripa and Drona, none of these approved of that game.

sa: अन्तरेण कलिङ्गानां पाण्डवानां च वाहिनीम्। तां संततार दुस्तारां भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Bhimasena crossed the inaccessible blood river flowing between Kalinga and arıny of Pandavas by virtue of his unique valour.

sa: स तु राजा महाभागो दृष्ट्वा देवर्षिसत्तमम्। पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं कथामकथयत् तदा॥
en: That monarch of illustrious qualities, beholding the sage come, worshipped him duly and then spoke to him these words.

sa: स भवान् सर्वसैन्येन परिवार्य पितामहम्। समरे कर्म कुर्वाणं दुष्करं परिरक्षतु॥
en: Therefore surrounding the grandsire with all our troops, do you protect him as he accomplishes difficult feats in battle.”

sa: ततो राजानमावृत्तं सौभद्रं प्रति संयुगे। दृष्ट्वा द्रोणोऽब्रवीद् योधान् परीप्सध्वं नराधिपम्॥
en: Then seeing the king turn back upon Subhadra's son in battle, Drona addressed the warriors saying "Save the king.

sa: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्। तस्मात् सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Action is produced from Brahma; Brahma is produced from the Imperishable. Therefore, all-pervading Brahma is always in the Sacrifice.

sa: तथा पाण्डुसुताः पार्थं चिह्नमात्रेण जज्ञिरे। तयोवरयोदृष्ट्वा तादृशं तं पराक्रमम्॥ विस्मयं सर्वभूतानि जग्मुर्भारत संयुगे। न तयोविवरं कश्चिद् रणे पश्यति भारत॥ धर्मेस्थितस्य हि यथा न कश्चिद् वृजिनं क्वचित्। उभौ च शरजालेन तावदृश्यौ बभूवतुः॥
en: So could the Pandavas also come to Partha by recognising his standard alone. O king, seeing the prowess thus displayed by those two foremost of men, O descendant of Bharata, all persons in that great battle were filled with wonder. None marked any difference between the two. Both of them were perfectly invisible by their continuous showers of arrows.

sa: न निवर्तयितुं चापि शक्येयं महती चमूः। अन्योन्यप्रेक्षया पश्य द्रवतीयं वरूथिनी॥
en: This our vast army is now impossible to be rallied. Behold, loO king at me, they are running away.

sa: नाभागोऽथ ययातिश्च मान्धाता नहुषो नृगः। संसिद्धाः परमं स्थानं गताः कर्मभिरीदृशैः॥
en: Nabhaga, Yayati, Mandhata, Nahusha and Bhrigu all secured success and obtained the highest region of bliss by such feats.

sa: उल्काश्च शतश: पेतुः सनिर्घाता: सकम्पनाः। अर्कं च सहसा दीप्तं स्वर्भानुरभिसंवृणोत्॥
en: Meteors too fell by hundreds and thousands and roared, making everything shake. And suddenly Rahu swallowed the shining sun.

sa: स समप्रहारस्तुमुल: सुघोरः समपद्यत। पार्षतस्य च शूरस्य दुर्मुखस्य च भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, ensued a terrible and dreadful battle between the war-like son of Prishata and the heroic Durmukha.

sa: अमृद्गात् समरे नागः सम्प्रधावंस्ततस्ततः। तेन संलोड्यमानं तु पाण्डवानां बलं महत्॥
en: It also crushed foot-soldiers by hundreds and by thousands. Thus agitated by it, that mighty army of the Pandavas,

sa: तथैव पाण्डवानां च रक्षितः सव्यसाचिना। नाभिद्यत महाव्यूहो भीमेन च सुरक्षितः॥
en: So did the formidable Pandava Vyuha remain unbroken, protected as it was by Savyasachi (Arjuna), and well-guarded by Bhima.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ययौ व्यासो धृतराष्ट्राय धीमते। धृतराष्ट्रोऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus spoken to Dhritarashtra Vyasa went away. Having heard these words, Dhritarashtra also reflected in silence.

sa: शुक्रः प्रोष्ठपदे पूर्वे समारुह्य विरोचते। उत्तरे तु परिक्रम्य सहितः समुदीक्षते॥
en: The planet Shukra rises towards Purva Bhadra. Shining brilliantly and shooting towards the Uttara Bhadra, it looks towards it.

sa: न चापि भीस्त्वया कार्या भीष्मादद्य कथंचना अहमेनं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पातयिष्ये रथोत्तमात्॥
en: You should entertain no fear from Bhishma today, I will dislodge him from his excellent car with sharp arrows."

sa: युयुधानः पुनद्रोणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः। एकेन सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Once more Yuyudhana pierced Drona with ten shafts, his charioteer with one, his four steeds with four other arrows.

sa: तान् प्रभग्नांस्तथा दृष्ट्वा द्रोणो द्रौणिर्वृहद्बलः। कृपो दुर्योधनः कर्णः कृतवर्माऽथ सौबलः॥
en: Beholding then the troops thus broken, Drona and his son and Brihadbala, Kripa, Duryodhana, Karna, Kritavarman and Subala's son.

sa: ततः प्राज्ञतमः कश्चिड्डिण्डिको नाम मूषिकः। अब्रवीद् वचनं राजन् मूषिकाणां महागणम्॥
en: Then the wisest among the mice, one named Dindika said these words in the assembly of the rats, Oking.

sa: शिखण्डी तु समासाद्य भरतानां पितामहम्। अभ्यद्रवत संहृष्टो भयं त्यक्त्वा महारथात्॥
en: Shikhandin also approaching the grandsire of the Bharatas delightedly rushed at him, harboring no fear from that mighty car-warrior.

sa: विचरन् स तदा राजन सेनां संक्षोभयन् प्रभुः। वर्धयामास संत्रासं शात्रवाणाममानुषम्॥
en: Then, O king, that puissant one careering through the troops of the enemy and agitating them, aggravated their fears.

sa: मम पुत्रा दुरात्मानः सर्वे मृत्युवशानुगाः। येषां युद्धं दुराधर्षेः पाण्डवैः प्रत्युपस्थितम्॥
en: My wicked-minded sons, who will have to fight with the invincible Pandavas are all under the influence of Death.

sa: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान् सत्कृत्यानवमन्य च। यदा सम्यक् प्रगृह्णाति स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Paying proper honours to Ritwijas and priests and preceptors, and doing them good, form the duty of the king.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य तथ्यं वचनमुत्तमम्। साश्रुकण्ठः स धर्मज्ञो जनार्दनमुवाच ह॥ यद् भवानाह भीष्मस्य प्रभावं प्रति माधव। तथा तन्नात्र संदेहो विद्यते मम माधव।॥
en: Hearing these wholesome and pregnant words of Vasudeva, the righteous Yudhishthira, with voice suppressed with tears, answered Janardana saying—'What you have said, O Madhava, about the greatness of Bhishma, is perfectly true. I have not the least doubt about it.

sa: ये त्विमे निशिताः पीताः पृथवो दीघवाससः। हेमपुङ्खास्त्रिपर्वाणो राज्ञ एते महाशराः॥
en: These great arrows, sharpened, yellow, heavy, long, gold feathered and consisting of three knots, belong to the king (Yudhishthira).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भगवन् विस्तरेणेमां कथां कथय तत्त्वतः। कथं तेन सुरेशेन नष्टा वसुमती तदा॥ योजनानां शतं ब्रह्मन् पुनरुद्धरिता तदा। केन चैव प्रकारेण जगतोधरणीध्रुवा॥ शिवा देवी महाभागा सर्वसस्यप्ररोहिणी। कस्य चैव प्रभावाद्धि योजनानां शतं गता॥ केन तद् वीर्यसर्वस्वं दर्शितं परमात्मनः। एतत् सर्वं यथातत्त्वमिच्छामि द्विजसत्तम। श्रोतुं विस्तरशः सर्वं त्वं हि तस्य प्रतिश्रयः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O exalted one, narrate in detail how Vishnu, the lord of the celestials, raised up the earth sunk down one hundred yojanas. How was also that support of all created things, the greatly blessed Earth, who dispenses blessings and produces all sorts of course, made stable? By whom she was forced to sink one hundred yojanas and under what circumstances was this greatest exploit of the Supreme Being exhibited? O foremost of Brahmanas, I desire to hear all this in detail as it happened. You know all about it.

sa: अथ कस्माद्धते क्षुद्रं कर्मेदं कृतवानसौ। द्रोणपुत्रो महात्मा स तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि॥
en: Why did that bowmen do this after the death of the wretched Duryodhana? You should tell me all this!"

sa: भवानपि तथा सम्यङ्मान्धातेव महीपते। धर्म कृत्वा महीं रक्ष स्वर्गे स्थानमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Do you also, O king, act righteously like Mandhatri. You will then, after ruling the Earth, live in heaven!

sa: धृष्टद्युम्ने सात्यकौ च भीमे चापि पराजिते। युधिष्ठिरस्य तैर्वाक्यैर्मर्मण्यपि च घट्टिते॥
en: Upon the defeat of Dhristadyumna, Satyaki and Bhima and cut to the quick by those words of king Yudhishthira.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भारद्वाजेन संवृतः। अभ्ययात् पाण्डवान् संख्ये ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: King Duryodhana, then, accompanied by the son of Bharadvaja, advanced against the Pandavas in battle. Then commenced a fight.

sa: ते भग्नाः प्रपतन्ति स्म निघ्नन्तश्च परस्परम्॥ न्यपातयंस्तथा चान्यान् पातयित्वा तदापिषन्।
en: Confused combatants rushed and killed one another, and felling those that stood in their way crushed them into pieces.

sa: एवं पार्थोऽभ्युपायात् स निहतः पाणिंसारथिः॥ अशक्नुवन् प्रमुखतः स्थातुं कर्णस्य दुर्मनाः।
en: Unable to stand before Karna, thus did the son of Pritha, with his charioteer Parshin slain, cheerlessly fly away.

sa: वृषभाविव गर्जन्तौ दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ॥ दैत्याविव बलोन्मत्तौ रेजतुस्तौ नरोत्तमौ। ततो दुर्योधनो राजन्निदमाह युधिष्ठिरम्॥ भ्रातृभिः संहितं चैव कृष्णेन च महात्मना। रामेणामितवीर्येण वाक्यं शौटीर्यसम्मतम्॥
en: Those two foremost of men then shone like a couple of Daityas swelling with pride. The Duryodhana, O king, said these haughty words unto Yudhishthira in the midst of his brothers and of the great Krishna and Rama.

sa: सात्यकिस्त्वाशु निष्क्रम्य केशवस्य समीपतः। दारुकं प्राह कृष्णस्य युज्यतां रथ इत्युत।॥
en: are At this Satyaki quickly left Keshava's company and going out, ordered Daruka, saying,-'Let Krishna's car be made ready.'

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्रस्य तं काममनुबुध्य युधिष्ठिरः। आत्मनश्चासहायत्वं तथेति प्रत्युवाच तम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Yudhisthira, understanding the motives of Dhritarashtra and knowing himself weak and friendless, said, “Be it so."

sa: किंचिदेव ममत्वेन यदा भवति कल्पितम्। तदेव परितापार्थं सर्वं सम्पद्यते तथा॥
en: That object, whatever it may be, which one considers as his own, is a source of grief and heart-burning.

sa: तांस्तु दैवहतान् पूर्वं पश्चाद् द्रौणिळपातयत्। त्रासयन् सर्वभूतानि विनदन भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: Assailed before by Destiny, they were now struck by Drona's son who terrified them all with the dreadful cries.

sa: स्फुरतो वेपमानांश्च शमितेव पशून् मखे।॥ ततो निस्त्रिंशमादाय जघानान्यान् पृथक् पृथक्।
en: He killed those trembling heroes like animals in a sacrifice. Taking up his sword then, he killed many others.

sa: वायसाश्चापि चाक्रन्दन् दिक्षु सर्वासु भैरवम्। रुधिरं चापि वर्षन्तो विनेदुस्तोयदा दिवि॥
en: Ravens fiercely croaked on all sides; on the sky clouds emitted roars of thunder and showered torrents of blood.

sa: स तं दृष्ट्वोग्रतपसं दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे विस्मयं परमं ययौ॥
en: Seeing that austere ascetic, as if blazing with prosperity, he became exceedingly glad and was filled with great wonder.

sa: स गृहीत्वा वसुमती शृङ्गेणेकेन भास्वता। योजनानां शतं वीर समुद्धरति सोऽक्षरः॥
en: O hero, then holding the earth with his single tusk that eternal one raised her up one hundred yojanas.

sa: आचार्यो नाभिवक्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता। देशकालौ तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य योद्धव्यमिति मे मतिः॥
en: No wise man can find fault with the preceptor. In my view we must fight considering time and place.

sa: नकुलस्तु भृशं विद्धः श्यालेन तव धन्विना। निषसाद रथोपस्थे कश्मलं चाविशन्महत्॥
en: Your brother-in-law wielder of bow, wounded Nakula extremely. He fell down on his chariot and filled with very grief.

sa: अगस्त्यश्चापि वैद( सावित्र्यां सत्यवान् यथा। यथा भृगुः पुलोमायामदित्यां कश्यपो यथा।॥
en: As Agastya with the princess of Vidarbha, as Satyavana with Savitri, as Bhrigu with Puloma, as Kashyapa with Aditi;

sa: शकुन्तलायां दुष्यन्तो धृत्यां धर्मश्च शाश्वतः। दमयन्त्यां नलश्चैव सत्यवत्यां च नारदः॥
en: As Dushyanta with Shakuntala, as the eternal Dharma with Dhirti, as Nala with Damayanti, and as Narada with Satyavati;

sa: समुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम्। भीमसेनस्तदा राजन् दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥ राज्ञापि धृतराष्ट्रेण त्वया चास्मासु यत् कृतम्। स्मर तद् दृष्कृतं कर्म यद् भूतं वारणावते॥
en: Seeing him stand there with uplifted mace like the created mountain of Kailasa, Bhimasena, O monarch, addressed him, saying "Remember all those wrongs that king Dhritarashtra and yourself have inflicted on us. Remember what took place at Varanavata.

sa: कृपाय च महाराज गुरुवृत्तिमवर्तत। विदुराय च राजासौ पूजां चक्रे यतव्रतः॥
en: O monarch, the king treated Kripa like a preceptor. Ever observing vows the king continued to honour Vidura highly.

sa: प्रणिपत्य महात्मानं राजर्षिः प्रत्यभाषत। यदि मे भगवान् प्रीतः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः॥ स्वयं मां देवदेवेश याजयस्व सुरेश्वर। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं राज्ञा तेन प्रभाषितम्॥
en: "O illustrious one, O chief of the celestial, O god of gods, if you are pleased with me, assist me then in my sacrifices.” Having heard these words of the king, the deity was pleased and smilingly replied,

sa: ततस्तूर्णं चित्रसेनो नाकुलिं नवभिः शरैः। विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धो भरतानां महारथः॥
en: Then Chitrasena, that great car-warrior among the Bharatas, quickly pierced the son of Nakula, in battle, with straight arrows.

sa: विव्याध च चतुःषष्ट्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥ सैन्धवाभिमुखं यान्तं योधाः सम्प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवम्।
en: And pierced him with four and sixty straight-going shafts. The Kuru warriors then seeing Pandu's son rush upon Jayadratha.

sa: तथैव नकुलस्यापि हयान् हत्वा प्रतापवान्। ईषां धनुश्च चिच्छेद माद्रीपुत्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: Having killed then Nakula's horses the powerful (Karna) sundered the bow and arrows of the intelligent son of Madri.

sa: निजधान सः। अयुतं दन्तिनां साधु कृपस्य पञ्चायुतानि चाश्वानां शकुनेर्निजघान ह॥
en: He also slew ten thousand tusked elephants that accompanied Kripa, as also fifty thousand horses that constituted Skuni's division.

sa: रथनेमिस्वनैश्चात्र विमिश्रः श्रूयते महान्। एते शब्दा भृशं तीव्राः प्रवृत्ताः कुरुसागरे॥
en: These terrible sounds in the ocean of Kuru army, are swelling every moment and causing my troops to tremble.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु ततो दिव्यमस्त्रं चक्रे हसन्निव। तदस्त्रं वारयामास ब्राह्मणो युधि भारत॥
en: Thereupon as if smiling Arjuna created a celestial weapon while, ( descendant of Bharata, the Brahmana baffled in battle.

sa: यद् यद्धि व्याक्षिपद युद्धे पाण्डवोऽस्त्रजिघांसया। तत् तदस्त्रं महेष्वासो द्रोणपुत्रो व्यसातयत्॥
en: Whatever weapon that the Pandava discharged in battle for killing the son of Drona, the great bowman made useless.

sa: तयोस्तु भृशसंक्रुद्धः शराभ्यां पाण्डुनन्दनः। धनुशी चिच्छिदे तूर्णं भूय एव धनंजयः॥
en: Then again, that son of Pandu Dhananjaya, inflamed with rage, quickly cut-off their bows with another pair of arrows.

sa: कर्णः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः कृपं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। शूरा गर्जन्ति सततं प्रावृषीव बलाहकाः॥
en: Karna, the foremost of smiters, spoke these words to Kripa. Heroes always roar like clouds during the rainy season.

sa: स कर्णं दशभिर्विद्ध्वा वृषसेनं च सप्तभिः। स हस्तावापधनुषी तयोश्चिच्छेद सात्वतः॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana then afflicted sore by Karna, forcibly pierced Karna with numerous shafts over and over again.

sa: भूरिश्रवाः शलः कर्णो वृषसेनो जयद्रथः। कृपश्च मद्रराजश्च द्रौणिश्च रथिनां वरः॥
en: Bhurishravas, Sala, Karna Vrishasena Jayadratha, Kripa, the ruler of the Madras and that foremost of car-warriors viz., Drona's son.

sa: एतं भारत मातङ्गा कर्णेनभिहताः शरैः। आर्तनादान विकुर्वाणा विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश॥
en: Struck by Karna in battle, O Arjuna the elephants are flying away in ten directions yelling cries of pain.

sa: ततः किरीटी भीमश्च सहसा संन्यवर्तताम्। महद्भयां रथवंशाभ्यां परिगृह्य बलं तदा॥
en: Then Kiriti and Bhima, rallying their own ariny, all on a sudden attacked, with a great car-force, your army.

sa: संजय उवाच एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णः पार्थ वचनमब्रवीत्। दर्शयन्निव कौन्तेयं धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Sanjaya said In the meantime pointing out the righteous king Yudhishthira to Parthia, the son of Kunti, Krishna said-

sa: वादित्राणि च दिव्यानि प्रावाद्यन्त सहस्रशः। सिंहनादांश्च चक्रुस्ते दृष्ट्वा संख्ये तदद्भुतम्॥
en: Thousands of musical instruments of swell tune were struck. Seeing those wonderful feats the heroes sent up leonine shouts.

sa: यः शस्त्रभृच्छ्रेष्ठतमः पृथिव्यां पितामहं व्याक्षिपदल्पचेताः। संख्यायमानोऽर्धरथः स कचित् त्वया हतोऽद्याधिरथिर्महात्मन्॥
en: That dull-headed Karna who had upbraided the foremost warrior in the course of the tale of Rathas and Atirathas?

sa: सततं च त्वमश्रौषीर्वचनं द्रोणभीष्मयोः। अवध्यौ वदन्तः कृष्णौ संनिधौ च महीक्षिताम्॥
en: You have always heard Drona and Bhishma speaking before all the kings of the two Krishnas as being unslayable.

sa: क्षिप्रमभ्यपतत् कर्णः परीप्संस्तनयं तव॥ न तु तं मर्षयामास भीमसेनो महाबलः।
en: Karna quickly advanced to rescue your son. But the mighty Bhimasena did not allow him to arose do so.

sa: अनुपादे तु यो वामस्तत्र शल्यो व्यवस्थितः। महत्या सेनया सार्धं मद्रदेशसमुत्थया॥
en: There Shalya was placed in left hind-foot accompanied by a vast army recruited from the country of the Madras.

sa: युध्यमानं तु संरम्भाद् भीमसेनं हसन्निवा अभ्यपद्यत कौन्तेयं कर्णो राजन् वृकोदरम्॥
en: The wrathful son of Radha then seemed to insult with his smiles, Bhimasena who was fighting in great anger.

sa: जयाशा यत्र पुत्रस्य मम मन्दस्य संयुगे। स कथं भीमकर्माणं भीमसेनमयोधयत्॥
en: How did that one, on whom my wicked son's hope of victory rested, fight with Bhimasena of fierce deeds.

sa: यदि रुद्रो द्विधाकृत्य युध्येतात्मानमात्मना। तत्र शक्योपमा कर्तुमन्यत्र तु न विद्यते॥
en: If Rudra, dividing himself in twain, fights with himself, then an example may be obtained that may match it.

sa: युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो यत्त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु। उपारमख युद्धे त्वं द्रोणाद् भरतसत्तम॥
en: "O mighty armed Yudhishthira, hear wihat I tell you. O foremost of the Bharatas, do not fight with Drona.

sa: बाह्येन सेनामभ्येत्य जग्मतुः सव्यसाचिनम्॥ यौ तु पूर्व महाराज वारितौ कृतवर्मणा।
en: Were proceeding towards Savyasachin, by the skirts of the Kaurava troops. The two princes o monarch, checked by Kritavarman.

sa: एष द्रोणं तथा भोजं कृतवर्माणमेव च। कदर्थीकृत्य विशिखैः फाल्गुनाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥
en: Having worsted with his arrows, Drona and Kritavarman of the Bhoja race, this Satyaki is approaching you, O Phalguna.

sa: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव स्वयमेव च सैन्धवः॥ समासाद्य च बीभत्सुः सैन्धवं समुपस्थितम्।
en: Ashvatthaman, Kripa and the ruler of the Sindhus himself; encountering the Sindhu king who was standing before him, Vibhatsu.

sa: उद्देशेन हि तेन स्म समयुध्यन्त पार्थिवाः। विरथा रथिनो राजन् समासाद्य परस्परम्॥ केशेषु समसज्जन्त कवचेषु भुजेषु च। हताश्वा हतसूताश्च निश्चेष्टा रथिनो हताः॥ जीवन्त इव तत्र स्म व्यदृश्यन्त भयार्दिताः। हतान् गजान् समाश्लिष्य पर्वतानिव वाजिनः॥ गतसत्त्वा व्यदृश्यन्त तथैव सह सादिभिः। ततस्त्वभ्यवसृत्यैव संग्रामादुत्तरां दिशम्॥
en: For this reason, the royal combatants fought on guided by conjecture and the challenges they uttered. Destitute of chariots, the carwarriors, O monarch, encountering another, lost all order and became confounded mass. Their horses slain the charioteer killed, many, becoming incapacitated, saved their lives and looked highly frightened. Staughtered steeds, with their riders slain, were seen to lie over elephants as if prostrate on mountain tops. Then Drona, inoving towards the northern quarter of the field.

sa: पतङ्गं हि ग्रसेचाषो यथा क्षुद्रं बुभुक्षितः। तथा द्रोणोऽग्रसच्छूरो धृष्टकेतुं महाहवे॥
en: Like a hungry jay catching and devouring a little insect, Drona of great heroism devoured Dhristaketu in that battle.

sa: तस्य द्रोणो हयान् हत्वा चतुर्भिश्चतुरः शरैः। सारथेश्च शिरः कायाचकर्त प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Then Drona slaying with four arrows his four steeds, smilingly severed the head of his charioteer from his trunk.

sa: ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य तावकस्य विशाम्पते। महानादो ह्यभूत् तत्र दृष्ट्वा राजानमाहवे॥
en: Then beholding the king proceed to the battle, all your troops, O ruler of men, raised a loud uproar.

sa: द्रोणं तव सुतो राजन् पुनरेवेदमब्रवीत्। अहं दुःशासनः कर्णः शकुनिर्मातुलश्च मे॥
en: Dividing this Bharata army in two, today, myself, Dushasana, Karna and my uncle Sakuni will slay Arjuna in battle.

sa: राजन् विदितमेतद् वै यथा गाण्डीवधन्वनः। प्रतिज्ञा सत्यसंधस्य गाण्डीवं प्रति विश्रुता॥
en: O king! you know already the vow of the veracious wielder of the Gandiva, in respect of his Gandiva.

sa: काल्यमानं तु तत् सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा फाल्गुनः। किंचिदागतसंरम्भो गुरुं पार्थोऽभ्ययाद् द्रुतम्॥
en: Seeing that are army was being slaughtered by Drona, Phalguna Partha, enraged a little, advanced speedily against his preceptor.

sa: तत्र युद्धं महवासीत् तावकानां विशाम्पते। शूरेण बलिना सार्धं पाण्डवेन किरीटिना॥
en: Then there took place a dreadful encounter between your army, O king and the heroic, diadem-decked son of Pandu.

sa: घटोत्कचे तु निहते सूतपुत्रेण तां निशाम्। दुःखामर्षवशं प्राप्तो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Upon the slaughter of Ghatotkacha during that night by Suta's Karna, king Yudhishthira was overwhelmed with grief and wrath.

sa: त्वयि वैकुव्यमापन्ने संशयो विजये भवेत्। श्रुत्वा कृष्णस्य वचनं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: If you are overtaken by depression victory becomes uncertain." Hearing these words of Krishna the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: संजय उवाच क्षत्रियास्ते महाराज परस्परवधैषिणः। अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुः कृतवैरा: परस्परम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Desirous of slaying one another and cherishing hatred, the Kshatriyas, O monarch, killed one another in battle.

sa: शूराणां गर्जतां तत्र ह्यविच्छेदकृता गिरः॥ श्रूयन्ते विविधा राजन् नामान्युद्दिश्य भारत।
en: O descendant of Bharata, as those warriors called one another by name a regular confusion of voices was heard.

sa: ते सेने भृशसंसक्ते दृष्ट्वान्योन्यं महाहवे॥ हर्षेण महता युक्ते परिगृह्य परस्परम्।
en: Furiously engaged in fight the two armies became filled with delight as the warriors saw and seized one another.

sa: बाणशब्दरवश्चोग्रः शुश्रुवे तत्र मारिष॥ अथ द्रोणो द्रुतं तत्र प्रत्यदृश्यत संयुगे।
en: And, O Bharata, sharp whiz's of arrows were also heard there. Then Drona speedily appeared there in that battle.

sa: दुःशासनं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा शकुनि षड्भिरायसैः। उलूकं च पतत्रिं च चकार विरथावुभौ॥
en: Striking Dushasana with ten iron arrows and Shakuni with six he deprived both Uluka and Patatri of their cars.

sa: संजय उवाच तदुदीर्णं गजानीकं बलं तव जनाधिप। पाण्डुसेनामतिक्रम्य योधयामास सर्वतः॥
en: Sanjaya said 0 monarch, that impetuous elephant squadron of yours fought everywhere getting the better of the Pandava army.

sa: वीरधन्वा ततः क्रुद्धो धृष्टकेतोः शरासनम्। द्विघा चिच्छेद भल्लेन प्रहसनिनव भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Viradhanva excited with rage smilingly cut-off the bow of Dhristaketu in twain with a broad-headed shaft.

sa: अलम्बुषोऽपि विक्षिप्य समुत्क्षिप्य च राक्षसम्। घटोत्कचं रणे रोषानिष्पिपेष च भूतले॥
en: Once more rose up quickly and rushed furiously upon the latter. Alambusha also, throwing down and dragging the Rakshasa.

sa: ततः कर्णस्य दुर्घषं स्यन्दनप्रवरं महत्॥ आरुरोह महातेजाः शल्यः सिंह इवाचलम्।
en: Then like a lion ascending a hill the highly energetic Shalya got upon the strong built car of Karna.

sa: तत्र वृद्धः पुरावृत्ताः कथा कश्चिद् द्विजोत्तमः। वाहीकदेशं मद्रांश्च कुत्सयन् वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: One aged and leading Brahmana among them, while recounting the ancient historian, said thus blaring the Balhikas and Madrakas.

sa: तदिदं वर्तते घोरमागतं वैशसं महत्। तस्यावमानाद् वाक्यस्य दुर्योधन कृते तव॥
en: In consequence of your disregard for those words, O Duryodhana, this dire, terrible and impending disaster has overtaken you.

sa: स पक्षाभ्यां स्पृशन्नार्तस्तुण्डेन च महार्णवे। काको दृढपरिश्रान्तः सहसा निपपात ह॥
en: Greatly tired and touching the ocean with his wings and beak the crow all on a sudden fell down.

sa: अक्रुध्यत भृशं तत्र कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। स भल्लास्त्रिशतस्तूर्णं तव पुत्रे न्यवेशयत्॥
en: At that Kunti's son Yudhishthira was greatly worked up with anger. He quickly struck your son with thirty darts.

sa: अव्यक्तं च महान्तं च तथाहङ्कार एव च। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥ एताः प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकारानपि मे शृणु। श्रोत्रं त्वक्चैव चक्षुश्च जिह्वा घ्राणं च पञ्चमम्॥ शब्दः स्पर्शच रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च। वाक् च हस्तौ च पादौ च पायुर्मेद्रं तथैव च॥
en: The Unmanifest, Greatness, Consciousness and the five subtile elements of Earth, Wind, Ether, water, and Light, these eight are known by the name of Nature. Listen now to the enumeration of those called changes. They are the ear, the skin, the eye, the tongue' and the nose; and sound, touch, form, taste, and scent, as also speech, the two arins, the two feet, the lower duct (within the body), and the organ of pleasure.

sa: प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मणस्तथा। सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम्॥
en: There, hearing of the welcome installation of Råma, had already come Sumitrā, and Lakşmaņa and Sītā summoned (by Kausalyā).

sa: नराणां च महायुद्धे सहस्राणि चतुर्दशः। दन्तिनां च सहस्राणि हयानामयुतं पुनः॥
en: In that fierce battle in addition to all this, fourteen thousand foot-soldiers, one thousand elephants, and ten thousand steeds.

sa: स तया सह संगम्य भार्यया कुरुनन्दनः। पाण्डुः परमधर्मात्मा युयुजे कालधर्मणा॥
en: The descendant of Kuru, virtuous minded Pandu succumbed to the inevitable influence of Time while united with his wife.

sa: ततः सोऽनिमिषो भूत्वा राजानं तमुदैक्षत। संयोज्य विदुरस्तस्मिन् दृष्टिं दृष्ट्या समाहितः॥
en: Meanwhile Vidura looked at the king steadfastly. Casting his look thus on the king, he stood motionless in Yoga.

sa: तदयं किं नु पापात्मा तव पुत्रः सुमन्दधी। पाण्डवान् नित्यसंक्रुद्धो राज्यहेतोर्जिघांसति॥
en: Why does your wicked-minded and sinful son angrily want to kill the Pandavas for the sake of the kingdom?

sa: इष्टा हि पाण्डवा नित्यमाचार्यस्य विशेषतः आसयनपरार्थाश्च कथ्यते स्म स्वयं तथा॥
en: The Pandavas are always the favourites of the preceptor. He betrays by his words that he is for others.

sa: गजानीकं महाराज वध्यमानं महात्मभिः। व्यदीर्यत दिशः सर्वा वातनुन्ना घना इव॥
en: O king, killed by great warriors, elephant divisions were dispersed in all directions like clouds scattered by the wind.

sa: ततस्त्वौशनसं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥
en: One should then go to Asanasha, celebrated all over the world, where Brahma and other celestials and ascetic Rishis.

sa: वृक्षेऽस्मिन् यानि पर्णानि फलान्यपि च बाहुक। पतितान्यपि यान्यत्र तत्रैकमधिकं शतम्॥ एकपत्राधिकं चात्र फलमेकं च बाहुका पञ्चकोट्योऽथ पत्राणां द्वयोरपि च शाखयोः॥ प्रचिनुगुह्यस्य शाखे द्वे याश्चाप्यन्याः प्रशाखिकाः। आभ्यां फलसहस्रे द्वे पञ्चोनं शतमेव च॥
en: O Bahuka, the leaves and fruits that have fallen from the tree (respectively) exceed the leaves and fruits, that are on the tree itself, by one hundred and one. O Bahuka, these two branches of the tree contain five millions of leaves. Examine the two branches and all their boughs and their fruits will number two thousand and ninety-five."

sa: यस्त्वया कृतसंवादः सीते ताम्रमुखः कपिः॥ लाफूलेन प्रदीप्तेन स एष परिणीयते।
en: O Sītā, the copper-faced monkey with whom you hadst held talk, is being led around with his tail flaming,

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणे रामे तु ताटका क्रोधमूर्च्छिता। उद्यम्य बाहुं गर्जन्ती राममेवाभ्यधावत॥
en: As Rāma was speaking thus, Tāțakā, deprived of sense through ire, uttering roars, with uplifted arms rushed against him.

sa: भयेन त्रिदशा राजञ्छरणं च प्रपेदिरे॥ तेन चैवातिकोपेन स यज्ञः संधितस्तदा।
en: Afraid, the gods sought his protection, O prince. His anger having subsided the great god re-established the sacrifice. arrows

sa: वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसाः कोपकर्कशाः। वेष्टन्ते तस्य लाङ्गूलं जीर्णैः कार्पासिकैः पटैः॥
en: Hearing his words, the Raksasas, cruel through wrath, cover up his (Hanumān's) tail with worn pieces of cotton cloth.

sa: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्। उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्॥
en: The food which is cold, not savory, stinky, corrupt, filthy and a refuse, is liked by men of Tama.

sa: तदिदं सफलं कर्म त्वयैव प्रतिगृह्यताम्। तथा चैवं विधत्स्वात्र यथा श्रेयोऽनुपश्यसि॥
en: Let this successful act be accepted by you; and in this matter, do whatsoever you think good and proper.

sa: वेधाभूतं करिष्यामि आत्मानं सुरसत्तमाः। तेन वृत्रं सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: I shall myself divide you into three classes and then forsooth your king shall be able to destroy Vrtra.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यं चरत्येष शिवा यास्य तनुस्तया। यास्य घोरतरा मूर्तिः सर्वानत्ति तयेश्वरः॥
en: With his auspicious form he practices the vow Brahmacharya, whereas with the dreadful form he has, he devours everything.

sa: एष दाशरथिः श्रीमान्सुग्रीवसहितो बली। समुद्रं लवयित्वा तु कुलं नः परिकृन्तति॥
en: This graceful son to Daśaratha possessed of strength, along with Sugriva, having crossed the ocean, is destroying our race.

sa: ते त्वर्चिता यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि यथाक्रमम्। मुदा परमया युक्ताः प्रीताश्चापि नरेश्वराः॥
en: Duly received in accordance the ordinance, these lords of men felt much delight and they were all well-pleased. to

sa: दुर्योधनस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा रात्रौ विलपितं बहु। मन्यमानः स तं राजन् प्रत्यादेशमिवात्मनः॥
en: Having heard those copious lamentation of Duryodhana in the night, and regarding them, O king, as commands to himself,

sa: भोजने भीमसेन्स्य पुनः प्राक्षेपयद् विषम्। कालकूटं नवं तीक्ष्णं सम्भृतं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Some time after, Duryodhana again mixed (with Bhima's food) poison which was fresh, virulent, fearful, hair stirring and deadly.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा वचः सौम्यं प्रत्युत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः। उभौ मुनिवरौ राजा जनको वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said these amiable words, king' Janaka arose, and with clasped hands addressed both the foremost of ascetics, saying.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सोदर्यैः परिवारितः। भीष्मं जुगोप समरे वर्तमाने जनक्षये॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana surrounded by his uterine brothers, protected Bhishma when that battle destructive of creatures was raging furiously.

sa: यथाच्छायातयौ नित्यं सुसम्बद्धौ निरन्तरम्। तथा कर्म च कर्ता च सम्बद्धावात्मकर्मभिः॥
en: As light and shadow are connected with each other, so are men related to Karma through their own deeds.

sa: रामस्य दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः। यथा हि विषयस्थानां बालानां मृत्युरागतः॥
en: Forsooth, Rāma has perpetrated a mighty iniquity for which boys, during his administration, have been meeting with untimely death.

sa: चतुर्थः पुष्पवान् नाम पञ्चमस्तु कुशेशयः। षष्ठो हरिगिरि म षडेते पर्वतोत्तमाः॥
en: The fourth mountain there is called Pushpavati, the fifth Kusheshaya, the sixty Harigiri. These are the six chief mountains.

sa: न ते चारयितुं शक्या राजन्वानरपुंगवाः। विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च राघवेण च रक्षिताः॥
en: Those powerful monkeys, o king, puissant, strong, and protected by Rāghava, are incapable of being ranged (by us). or

sa: एते देवगणाः सार्धमृषिभिर्गगने स्थिताः। निहतं त्वां रणे दृष्ट्वा निनदन्ति प्रहर्षिताः॥
en: These gods stationed in the sky along with the saints, beholding you slain the battle, are shouting in glee.

sa: तत्र तत्र हि दृश्यन्ते धातवः पाञ्चभौतिकाः। यैरावृतमिदं सर्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥ इन्द्रियैः सृज्यते यद् यत् तत् तद् व्यक्तमिति स्मृतम्। तदव्यक्तमिति ज्ञेयं लिङ्गचाह्यमतीन्द्रियम्॥
en: There (everlastingly) exist the five elementary substances of which all the mobile and immobile world is composed. Whatever is perceptible by the senses is called Vyakta (manifest) and whatever is not perceptible by the senses is called Avyakta (not manifest).

sa: अथास्य सशरं चापं पुनश्चिच्छेद मारिष। सारथिं च शरेणास्य भृशं मर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: He then cut-off his bow and arrows; then with another he pierced greatly his driver to the very vitals.

sa: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। वरायुधधरौ वीरौ सुग्रीवः शङ्कितोऽभवत्॥
en: Beholding those two high-souled brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, heroic and with great scimitars in their hands, Sugrīva became terrified.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः। अब्रवीत् तावकान् योधान् भीमोऽयं युधि वध्यताम्।।३१।
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, afflicted with the calamity that had befallen hill brothers, commanded his troops saying "Slay this Bhima."

sa: तस्मादेतत् त्रयं यत्नादुपसेवेत पण्डितः॥ गुरुणा चैव निर्बधो न कर्तव्यः कदाचन।
en: A wise man should, therefore, tend these three carefully. One should never engage in any disputation with his preceptor.

sa: गृहे यत् क्षत्रियस्यापि निधनं तद् विगर्हितम्। अधर्मः सुमहानेष यच्छय्यामरणं गृहे॥
en: The death a Kshatriya meets with at home is blamcable. Death on one's bed at home is highly sinful.

sa: तव प्रसादेन नृसिंह वीर प्रियां च राज्यं च समाप्नुयामहम्। तथा कुरु त्वं नरदेव वैरिणं यथा न हिंस्यात् स पुनर्ममाग्रजम् ॥
en: You lion among men! by your grace shall I obtain both my beloved and my monarchy. O God among men, do you so deal with that foe, my elder brother, that he may not again wrong venomous me.

sa: गच्छ पौलस्त्य विस्रब्धं पथा येन त्वमिच्छसि। मया चैवाभ्यनुज्ञातो राक्षसाधिप गम्यताम्॥
en: Go, O Paulastya, which way you wish with confidence, and permitted by me, O Lord of Raksasas, go you.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः क्रुद्धां विकृतां विकृताननाम्। प्रमामेनातिवृद्धां च लक्ष्मणं सोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: And beholding that frightful one of hideous visage and colossal proportions, transported with rage, Raghu's descendant spoke to Laksmana,9

sa: कथं दीनस्य सततं त्वामासाद्य रहोगताम्। तं विचिन्तयतः शापं प्रहर्षः समजायत॥
en: He was always melancholy, thinking the curse of the Rishi. How did he become marry with you in solitude?

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसाऽऽयान्तं वसुं ते त्वन्तरिक्षगम्॥ ऊचुर्द्विजातयो देवानेष च्छेत्स्यति संशयम्।
en: Seeing king Vasu coming there through the skies, the Brahmanas addressing the gods, said,-This one will dispell our doubts.

sa: वाल्येऽप्येतेन यत्कर्म कृतं राम महाबल। तन्न वर्णयितुं शक्यमिति वाल्यतयास्य ते॥
en: I am not capable of describing to you the wondrous childish feat which Hanuman did perform in his boyhood.

sa: विहाय कामं क्रोधं च तथाहंकारमेव च। युक्तो विवरमन्विच्छेदहितानां पुनः पुनः॥
en: Giving up lust, anger and pride, the king should carefully and continually watch for the shortcomings of his foes,

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं तु भगवान् सोमो यक्ष्मणा समगृह्यत। कथं च तीर्थप्रवरे तस्मिंश्चन्द्रो न्यमन्जत॥ कथमाप्लुत्य तस्मिंस्तु पुनराप्यायितः शशी। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामुने॥
en: Janamejaya said "For what was the worshipful Soma afflicted with phthisis? How also did he bathe in that tirtha? How did he, having bathed in that sacred water, regain his lost power? Describe it to me fully, O great Muni.

sa: अथेमां वेददृष्टेन कर्मणा विधिपूर्वकम्। भार्यामृषि गुः प्राप मां पुरस्कृत्य दानव॥
en: O Rakshasa, she was duly taken by Bhrigu as his wife in my presence with all the Vedic rites.

sa: एवं दत्त्वा वरान् राजन् रामस्य पितरस्तदा। आमन्त्र्य भार्गवं प्रीत्या तत्रैवान्तर्हितास्ततः॥
